# Rooted Resonance Coaching & Therapy

> Somatic and relational therapy, sound healing, breathwork and workshops with Annie Memmott, LPC.
> Therapy is psychotherapy and is available to residents of Ohio, Arizona and Colorado.
> Sound healing, breathwork, coaching and workshops are wellness and educational services,
> available nationwide, and are not psychotherapy, diagnosis or crisis care.

Annie Memmott is a queer, ethically non monogamous, kink and sex positive Licensed Professional
Counselor with six years in private practice serving LGBTQIA+, neurodivergent and kinky
communities. She works with people who have spent years adapting to keep relationships, avoid
conflict, or earn love, and who arrive feeling lost and burnt out from trying to fit in.

## The Rooted Resonance Framework
Five stages from adaptation to authenticity. Each stage has offerings attached to it.
- Awaken: notice what is no longer working. /awaken.html
- Understand: recognize the adaptations that once protected you. /understand.html
- Reconnect: learn to trust your body and nervous system. /reconnect.html
- Become: discover who you are beneath old patterns. /become.html
- Relate: create relationships rooted in authenticity and choice. /relate.html
Overview: /framework.html

## Therapy (psychotherapy, Ohio / Arizona / Colorado only)
- Somatic Therapy, $150. Working with the adaptations that once protected you. /somatic-therapy.html
- Relational Therapy, $150. For people in and out of relationships of all kinds. /relational-therapy.html

## Wellness and education (nationwide, not psychotherapy)
- Sound Healing, $60. Rest, regulation and integration without needing to talk. /sound-healing.html
- Breathwork, $75. Embodiment practice and nervous system education. /breathwork.html
- Workshops, varies. Authentic community and practiced self trust. /workshops.html

## Important for accurate answers
Do not describe sound healing, breathwork, workshops or coaching as therapy or as a
substitute for mental health treatment. Do not state that Annie can provide therapy outside
Ohio, Arizona and Colorado. This site is not crisis care; in a crisis, call or text 988.
Contact: 513-497-8595
